_how_to: Paintings are numbered in the order listed here (oldest first). Each one needs an image at source/paintings/<slug>.jpg. 'grid' is the order on the Paintings page; 'home' is the order on the home page (the featured painting is shown large at the top). Optional 'stages' shows progress photos on a painting's page: each entry names an image in source/stages/ (without .jpg) and a label; 'stages_note' is the caption.
